note: Israel's national spirits. The ones with `start` describe the situation on 1 January 2000 and cite sources; the others are granted by focuses and decisions. Values are gameplay estimates.

spirits.name: Compulsory service
spirits.description: Fixed-term military service has been compulsory since 1948 for Jewish men and women and for Druze and Circassian men.

spirits.name: Start-up nation
spirits.description: The Silicon Wadi on the coastal plain is a global centre of advanced technology.

spirits.name: The Oslo framework
spirits.description: The interim Israel-PLO agreements of 1993 and 1995 set the frame for relations with the Palestinians.

spirits.name: Rocket threat
spirits.description: Rockets from Gaza and Lebanon threaten the towns of the south and north.

spirits.name: Iron Dome
spirits.description: A mobile air-defence system intercepts short-range rockets.

spirits.name: Offshore gas
spirits.description: Gas from the offshore fields supplies power plants and exports.

spirits.name: Cyber power
spirits.description: A world-class cyber industry and military cyber units.

spirits.name: Desalinated water
spirits.description: Desalination plants end the water shortage.

spirits.name: A divided society
spirits.description: Mass protests and a deeply split public.

spirits.name: National unity
spirits.description: Parties and the public rally together in a crisis.
